name: TCS

rounds.name: TCS NQT - Foundation + Advanced
rounds.detail: Numerical ability, verbal, reasoning, programming logic + 2 hands-on coding questions.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.detail: Final-year project, Java/C fundamentals, DBMS basics, one coding question on paper.

rounds.name: Managerial + HR Round
rounds.detail: Relocation flexibility, shift readiness, service agreement, communication.

aptitudePatterns.sample: A shirt marked at Rs. 1200 is sold after two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. Find the selling price.
A does a job in 12 days, B in 18 days. Working together, how many days for 3 such jobs?
4, 9, 19, 39, ? - find the next term and the rule.

codingPatterns.sample: Reverse words in a sentence without reversing characters inside a word.
Find the second largest element in an array in a single pass.
Print the Fibonacci series up to N terms using recursion.

hrQuestions: Why TCS when you also cleared other companies?
Are you willing to relocate to any TCS location and work in any shift?
Explain your final year project to a non-technical person.
tips: NQT sectional cut-offs matter - never leave a section blank-heavy.
Service agreement (bond) details are asked in HR - read them before the interview.
Digital/Prime coding is a function-completion format; practise exact I/O.
